CustomField.label: Allow New Records
CustomField.description: Checked: the grid has a New button for users who can create its records, and may allow import. The new record is a row at the top, saved with the other changes; Salesforce's New form opens instead when the grid can't fill in all it needs.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Uncheck to hide the grid's New button. Unchecked, the grid offers no import either.
